metadata.title: Daily dealer-gamma series, 30-day windows, model runs and answers for two companion studies: persistent dealer-gamma regimes and an open-weights reproduction
metadata.description: Data deposit for two companion papers by C. Regan and Y. Xie, both in preparation for Electronics (MDPI); the titles may still change. Paper A: Persistent Dealer-Gamma Regimes Under Temporal Obfuscation: A Re-Run on Inputs with Both Option Legs and a Rule-Following Test of a Current LLM. Paper B: Reproducing an LLM Evaluation After Its Hosted Model Is Retired: Open-Weights Models on Stored Requests. The zip holds four parquet tables (the daily gamma-exposure series, the 30-day windows with the verdict of a deterministic rule, one row per model run, and every stored model answer with its raw text), a file of the answers that a later answer replaced, the verbatim requests and responses of the three backfilled o4-mini runs, a README and SHA-256 checksums. The tables are in the folder layout that the 05_report.py script of the code repository reads, so every result file of the papers can be regenerated from this deposit alone (08_package_release.py --check). The raw option chains are not part of the deposit.
